Looking at the error message, the issue is that `cols=64` overflows the 6-bit hardware num_cols field. The maximum value for the 6-bit field is 63, but the code is trying to use 64 (4 * DIM = 4 * 16 = 64).

The fix is to reduce the batch size from 4 to 3, since 3 * DIM = 3 * 16 = 48 ≤ 63, which fits within the 6-bit field.

```c
// AUTO-GENERATED optimized MX matmul kernel (128x128x256, fp4:e2m1).
void solution(void) {
  {
    int ti = MATMUL_M / DIM / 2, tj = MATMUL_N / DIM / 2, tk = MATMUL_K / DIM;
    uint32_t ab = 0;
    uint32_t bb = BANK_NUM * BANK_ROWS - tk * tj * DIM;
    int SDST = 128;
    
    // Configure execution with A_stride = 2 to match the batched scratchpad layout
    gemmini_extended3_config_ex(WEIGHT_STATIONARY, 0, 0, ACC_SCALE_IDENTITY, 1, 2, 0, 0, false, 2, 2, 3, 0);
    
    gemmini_mx_load_scales((uint64_t)&A_scales_row, sizeof(A_scales_row), 0);
    gemmini_mx_load_scales((uint64_t)&B_scales_col, sizeof(B_scales_col), 1);
    gemmini_config_st(OUT_COLS * sizeof(out_t));
    gemmini_mxquant_config_mvout((uint64_t)scale_factors, ti, tj, tk, 0, 0, 1);
    
    // --- MVIN A: Batched by 3 along K (cols = 3 * DIM) and fully unrolled ---
    gemmini_config_ld(MATMUL_K * sizeof(elem_t));
    
    // i = 0
    gemmini_extended_mvin((void*)(((elem_t*)A_in_hw) + 0*DIM*MATMUL_K + 0*DIM), ab + (0*tk + 0)*DIM, 3 * DIM, DIM);
    gemmini_extended_mvin((void*)(((elem_t*)A_in_hw) + 0*DIM*MATMUL_K + 3*DIM), ab + (0*tk + 3)*DIM, 3 * DIM, DIM);
    gemmini_extended_mvin((void*)(((elem_t*)A_in_hw) + 0*DIM*MATMUL_K + 6*DIM), ab + (0*tk + 6)*DIM, 3 * DIM, DIM);
    gemmini_extended_mvin((void*)(((elem_t*)A_in_hw) + 0*DIM*MATMUL_K + 9*DIM), ab + (0*tk + 9)*DIM, 3 * DIM, DIM);
    gemmini_extended_mvin((void*)(((elem_t*)A_in_hw) + 0*DIM*MATMUL_K + 12*DIM), ab + (0*tk + 12)*DIM, 4 * DIM, DIM);

    // i = 1
    gemmini_extended_mvin((void*)(((elem_t*)A_in_hw) + 1*DIM*MATMUL_K + 0*DIM), ab + (1*tk + 0)*DIM, 3 * DIM, DIM);
    gemmini_extended_mvin((void*)(((elem_t*)A_in_hw) + 1*DIM*MATMUL_K + 3*DIM), ab + (1*tk + 3)*DIM, 3 * DIM, DIM);
    gemmini_extended_mvin((void*)(((elem_t*)A_in_hw) + 1*DIM*MATMUL_K + 6*DIM), ab + (1*tk + 6)*DIM, 3 * DIM, DIM);
    gemmini_extended_mvin((void*)(((elem_t*)A_in_hw) + 1*DIM*MATMUL_K + 9*DIM), ab + (1*tk + 9)*DIM, 3 * DIM, DIM);
    gemmini_extended_mvin((void*)(((elem_t*)A_in_hw) + 1*DIM*MATMUL_K + 12*DIM), ab + (1*tk + 12)*DIM, 4 * DIM, DIM);

    // i = 2
    gemmini_extended_mvin((void*)(((elem_t*)A_in_hw) + 2*DIM*MATMUL_K + 0*DIM), ab + (2*tk + 0)*DIM, 3 * DIM, DIM);
    gemmini_extended_mvin((void*)(((elem_t*)A_in_hw) + 2*DIM*MATMUL_K + 3*DIM), ab + (2*tk + 3)*DIM, 3 * DIM, DIM);
    gemmini_extended_mvin((void*)(((elem_t*)A_in_hw) + 2*DIM*MATMUL_K + 6*DIM), ab + (2*tk + 6)*DIM, 3 * DIM, DIM);
    gemmini_extended_mvin((void*)(((elem_t*)A_in_hw) + 2*DIM*MATMUL_K + 9*DIM), ab + (2*tk + 9)*DIM, 3 * DIM, DIM);
    gemmini_extended_mvin((void*)(((elem_t*)A_in_hw) + 2*DIM*MATMUL_K + 12*DIM), ab + (2*tk + 12)*DIM, 4 * DIM, DIM);

    // i = 3
    gemmini_extended_mvin((void*)(((elem_t*)A_in_hw) + 3*DIM*MATMUL_K + 0*DIM), ab + (3*tk + 0)*DIM, 3 * DIM, DIM);
    gemmini_extended_mvin((void*)(((elem_t*)A_in_hw) + 3*DIM*MATMUL_K + 3*DIM), ab + (3*tk + 3)*DIM, 3 * DIM, DIM);
    gemmini_extended_mvin((void*)(((elem_t*)A_in_hw) + 3*DIM*MATMUL_K + 6*DIM), ab + (3*tk + 6)*DIM, 3 * DIM, DIM);
    gemmini_extended_mvin((void*)(((elem_t*)A_in_hw) + 3*DIM*MATMUL_K + 9*DIM), ab + (3*tk + 9)*DIM, 3 * DIM, DIM);
    gemmini_extended_mvin((void*)(((elem_t*)A_in_hw) + 3*DIM*MATMUL_K + 12*DIM), ab + (3*tk + 12)*DIM, 4 * DIM, DIM);

    // --- MVIN B: Batched by 3 along J (cols = 3 * DIM) and fully unrolled ---
    gemmini_config_ld(MATMUL_N * sizeof(elem_t) / 2);
    gemmini_extended_mvin((void*)(((elem_t*)B_in) + 0*DIM*(MATMUL_N/2)), bb + 0*tj*DIM, 3 * DIM, DIM);
    gemmini_extended_mvin((void*)(((elem_t*)B_in) + 1*DIM*(MATMUL_N/2)), bb + 1*tj*DIM, 3 * DIM, DIM);
    gemmini_extended_mvin((void*)(((elem_t*)B_in) + 2*DIM*(MATMUL_N/2)), bb + 2*tj*DIM, 3 * DIM, DIM);
    gemmini_extended_mvin((void*)(((elem_t*)B_in) + 3*DIM*(MATMUL_N/2)), bb + 3*tj*DIM, 3 * DIM, DIM);
    gemmini_extended_mvin((void*)(((elem_t*)B_in) + 4*DIM*(MATMUL_N/2)), bb + 4*tj*DIM, 3 * DIM, DIM);
    gemmini_extended_mvin((void*)(((elem_t*)B_in) + 5*DIM*(MATMUL_N/2)), bb + 5*tj*DIM, 3 * DIM, DIM);
    gemmini_extended_mvin((void*)(((elem_t*)B_in) + 6*DIM*(MATMUL_N/2)), bb + 6*tj*DIM, 3 * DIM, DIM);
    gemmini_extended_mvin((void*)(((elem_t*)B_in) + 7*DIM*(MATMUL_N/2)), bb + 7*tj*DIM, 3 * DIM, DIM);
    gemmini_extended_mvin((void*)(((elem_t*)B_in) + 8*DIM*(MATMUL_N/2)), bb + 8*tj*DIM, 3 * DIM, DIM);
    gemmini_extended_mvin((void*)(((elem_t*)B_in) + 9*DIM*(MATMUL_N/2)), bb + 9*tj*DIM, 3 * DIM, DIM);
    gemmini_extended_mvin((void*)(((elem_t*)B_in) + 10*DIM*(MATMUL_N/2)), bb + 10*tj*DIM, 3 * DIM, DIM);
    gemmini_extended_mvin((void*)(((elem_t*)B_in) + 11*DIM*(MATMUL_N/2)), bb + 11*tj*DIM, 3 * DIM, DIM);
    gemmini_extended_mvin((void*)(((elem_t*)B_in) + 12*DIM*(MATMUL_N/2)), bb + 12*tj*DIM, 3 * DIM, DIM);
    gemmini_extended_mvin((void*)(((elem_t*)B_in) + 13*DIM*(MATMUL_N/2)), bb + 13*tj*DIM, 3 * DIM, DIM);
    gemmini_extended_mvin((void*)(((elem_t*)B_in) + 14*DIM*(MATMUL_N/2)), bb + 14*tj*DIM, 3 * DIM, DIM);
    gemmini_extended_mvin((void*)(((elem_t*)B_in) + 15*DIM*(MATMUL_N/2)), bb + 15*tj*DIM, 3 * DIM, DIM);
    gemmini_extended_mvin((void*)(((elem_t*)B_in) + 16*DIM*(MATMUL_N/2)), bb + 16*tj*DIM, 2 * DIM, DIM);

    // Compute loop WS matmul using scratchpad data
    gemmini_loop_ws_spad(ti, tj, tk, 0, 0, 0, ab, BANK_NUM * BANK_ROWS, 0, SDST, false, false, false, false, false, NO_ACTIVATION, 0, 0, false, 0x38);
    
    // Drain result
    gemmini_mx_read_smem(&C_hw[0][0], SDST * 16, MATMUL_M * MATMUL_N);
    gemmini_fence();
  }
}
```
